1.text: Kandi ubwo dukorana na yo, turabinginga kugira ngo mudaherwa ubuntu bw'Imana gupfa ubusa,

2.text: kuko yavuze iti“Mu gihe cyo kwemererwamo narakumviye,No ku munsi wo gukirizwamo naragutabaye.”Dore none ni cyo gihe cyo kwemererwamo, dore none ni wo munsi wo gukirizwamo.

3.text: Ntitugire igisitaza dushyira mu nzira y'umuntu wese, kugira ngo umurimo wacu utagira umugayo.

4.text: Ahubwo ku kintu cyose twihe agaciro nk'abakozi b'Imana bagabura ibyayo, twihangana cyane mu makuba, mu mibabaro, mu byago,

5.text: mu biboko, mu mazu y'imbohe, mu midugararo, no mu mihati; tuba maso, twirirwa ubusa,

6.text: dufite umutima uboneye, dufite ubwenge, tutarambirwa, tugira neza, dufite Umwuka Wera, dufite n'urukundo rutaryarya;

7.text: tuvuga ijambo ry'ukuri, dufite imbaraga z'Imana kandi dufite intwaro zo gukiranuka z'iburyo n'iz'ibumoso,

8.text: mu cyubahiro no mu buhemu, mu mugayo no mu ishimwe. Dutekerezwa ko turi abashukanyi ariko turi ab'ukuri,

9.text: dutekerezwa ko turi abatamenyekana nyamara turi ibirangirire, dusa n'abagiye gupfa ariko dore turi bazima, dusa n'abahanwa ariko ntitwicwa,

10.text: dusa n'abababara ariko twishima iteka, dusa n'abakene nyamara dutungisha benshi, dusa n'abatagira icyo bafite nyamara dufite byose.

11.text: Mwa Bakorinto mwe, akanwa kacu karababumbukiye, umutima wacu uragūtse.

12.text: Ntimubyigana muri twe, ahubwo mubyigana mu mitima yanyu ubwanyu.

13.text: Nuko ndababwira nk'abana banjye, namwe mwaguke kugira ngo mwiture nk'uko mwagiriwe.

14.text: Ntimwifatanye n'abatizera mudahwanye. Mbese gukiranuka no gukiranirwa byafatanya bite? Cyangwa umucyo n'umwijima byabana bite?

15.text: Kandi Kristo ahuriye he na Beliyali, cyangwa uwizera n'utizera bafitanye mugabane ki?

16.text: Mbese urusengero rw'Imana rwahuza rute n'ibishushanyo bisengwa, ko turi urusengero rw'Imana ihoraho? Nk'uko Imana yabivuze iti“Nzatura muri bo ngendere muri bo,Nzaba Imana yabo na bo bazaba ubwoko bwanjye.

17.text: Nuko muve hagati ya ba bandi,Mwitandukanye ni ko Uwiteka avuga,Kandi ntimugakore ku kintu gihumanye.Nanjye nzabākīra,

18.text: Kandi nzababera So,Namwe muzambere abahungu n'abakobwa,Ni ko Uwiteka Ushoborabyose avuga.”
